text:
Maria: Quick thought — we should run a small experiment to triage the long-tail tech debt in the inference path. propose: a 'cohesion-workspace' repo that collects candidate service extracts, a lightweight cohesion score, and an ownership playbook. who wants to own the spike?
Kevin: +1. can you sketch the cohesion score? is it code churn, call graph tightness, runtime coupling?
Maria: thinking composite: weighted sum of call-edge density, shared-state surface, and deploy-surface churn. simple formula to start: cohesion = 100 - (10*shared_state_points + 5*cross_service_calls_per_min + churn_pct). just a heuristic to rank slices.
Anita: important we tie it to customer SLAs. any experiment must include a rollback signal (latency/error). also we can use feature flags for the cutover.
Charlie: agree with feature flags. for the first pass, do a non-invasive facade: move adapter logic behind a shim in front of target service, route 5% of traffic.
Maria: sketching runbook: 1) identify top 10 low-cohesion candidates from telemetry 2) create cohesion-workspace branch with adapter + tests 3) smoke canary at 5% 4) measure latency, p99, errors, cost delta 5) rollback if signals exceed thresholds.
Kevin: what thresholds? suggest p50+p95 within 5% and p99 within 10%, error rate delta < 0.2%. cost delta tolerable up to 3% for short window.
Anita: those are tight but reasonable. add regression alert on end-to-end quality (re-encode a small eval set and run similarity check).
Maria: noted. I'll add similarity check step to runbook. also creating the repo skeleton now.
Maria: command I used to scaffold: ```bash
mkdir cohesion-workspace && cd cohesion-workspace
git init && gh repo create redwood/cohesion-workspace --private
```
Charlie: nice. we should include a small harness to replay production traces (anonymized) — can run locally in CI for each candidate.
Anita: volunteer to own the trace-replay harness. will set up a minimal proto by EOD Friday.
Kevin: i'll draft the RFC follow-up with acceptance criteria and the rollout plan. one ask: add an ownership tag to each candidate so PMs know who's accountable.
Maria: agreed — ownership tag + estimated paydown effort (S/M/L) + risk note.
Charlie: small note — watch out for shared KV caches. if candidate touches the same KV keys heavily, extraction might be expensive; add that as a risk field.
Maria: good call. adding KV contention as a separate risk dimension.
infra-bot: deployment scheduled: cohesion-workspace/prototype to staging at 2025-04-18T09:00Z (automated)
Kevin: thanks infra-bot :thumbsup: once staging prototype is up let's run a smoke run with 1% traffic and the replay harness.
Maria: timeline proposal: spike week 1 — identify candidates and scaffold repos; week 2 — implement adapter shims and harness; week 3 — canary + metrics evaluation; week 4 — retro and next steps.
Anita: sounds good. i'll add tasks to the 'eng: modularization' board and tag owners.
Maria: ok team — thanks. action items: Kevin = RFC follow-up, Anita = replay harness + tasks, Charlie = adapter shim template, Maria = repo + runbook + cohesion metric calc. will sync next Tue. :calendar:
Kevin: ping me if you need data slices, I can export p99/p95 windows and call graphs.
Charlie: also recommend we add a 'rollback kill switch' env var for adapters to instantly route back to original service if something goes wrong.
Maria: will add kill-switch and a postmortem checklist to the runbook.
Kevin: sounds like a plan.
Anita: :rocket:
